articles.question: How do I run and interpret an embargo screening?
articles.answer: Perform an on-demand Quick embargo check from the shipment workspace or review automatic findings in the Full compliance audit panel. Shipments with non-US destinations automatically skip US-only partner government agency screening and regulatory deadline rules.
steps: Go to Shipments and open the relevant shipment workspace.
Locate the Compliance Checks panel on the shipment page.
Click Quick embargo check to execute an on-demand screening of shipment origin, destination, and private rules.
Check the Full compliance audit panel to review line-item findings generated automatically on document upload or edit.
